corrections: Replaced the previous use of Modelica.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Shapes.FixedShape.Cuboid with Modelica.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Basic.ConstantReluctance for CORE-L, CORE-U, CORE-R, and CORE-D because the brief requires the released baseline to be linear with constant effective relative permeability mu_r = 1200, and the reported preflight evidence states the FixedShape classes hardcode nonlinear permeability behavior and would not represent the released linear benchmark.

Replaced the previous custom LeakageFluxBranch based on Modelica.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Basic.LeakageWithCoefficient with a direct Modelica.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Basic.ConstantReluctance leak branch using R_leak = R_gap*(1-sigma)/sigma, because the brief explicitly gives that released benchmark relation and the reported preflight evidence states LeakageWithCoefficient requires an unconnected RealInput that leaves the system under-determined if omitted.

Rewired the useful-flux sensor in series in the GAP-1 branch by connecting CORE-R -> FluxSensor -> GAP-1 -> CORE-D, because the brief says FluxSensor reports useful air-gap flux through GAP-1; the previous port_p-to-port_p and port_n-to-port_n wiring placed the sensor in parallel across the gap rather than in the useful-flux path.
Kept the nominal released air gap delta = 0.00150 m in the executable benchmark and did not use the separate as-built 0.00158 m prototype gap, per the brief's resolved released-benchmark decision.

Assigned simulation tolerance 1e-6 in the experiment annotation because the brief says the notes do not state a solver tolerance directly and this assigned numerical tolerance was already resolved by Merge as an assumption.

The brief requires one electric ground and one magnetic ground. This bundle instantiates both. A second electrical reference connection is still present on the measuring coil circuit through MeasuringCoil.n to a dedicated ground instance; if the real compiler rejects that topology as an over-constrained electrical reference, the brief does not state the exact open-circuit instrumentation arrangement needed for the measuring coil and that wiring would need clarification rather than invention.
